[[File:Insecticide_mine.png|thumb|right|150px|An insecticide mine]]
An '''insecticide mine''' was a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] that contained [[Insecticide/Legends|insecticides]], poisons designed to kill [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. Many [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] used insecticide mines as defenses against the Killiks on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]; [[House Teral]] was unable to activate their insecticide mines when their [[House Teral (estate)|estate]] was invaded, and recruited help in retrieving the mines.
